refuted.reason: The crop (200,286 100x54, clamped at the 300 px edge) shows the High severity pill right after the 12.0.1 version, ending near x 264, with the rest of the row empty. That is the declared compact-row anatomy: the badge slot follows the name and version (DS-ROW-5, DS-ROW-7) and the row's end is the hover-action slot (DS-ROW-4 reads 'visible actions per row 0 ×29'). No rule, spec element or artboard element puts a row badge flush with the header count badge: DS-INSET-3 (b) applies to section-header trailing items, measured at 'section headers 6 ×2 (target 6)', and the cited artboard is the main panel's, which has no side-bar row. refuted.reason: The crop (clamped to x 199-300) shows the High pill ending at about x 263 with the row's action slot after it. No rule, redline or exemplar binds a compact row's badge to the row end or to the header count (DS-OVERFLOW-2 reads that count at 263.3-290, box right 296). The main-panel artboard is not this surface, so this falls under the §6 taste exclusion.

refuted.reason: The crop (clamped to x 12-249, the PNG is 250 wide) shows Newtonsoft.Json with '1...' and the High badge ending near x 213, then about 30 px of empty band. That empty band is the compact row's 32 px end slot (6 + 22 + 4), which the row's one action overlays. DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08 (UX-P3.7a, D47) declares it on purpose, and the padding-inline-end of .nuiget-row-option--compact implements it. The truncation follows the hard DS-ROW-5 rule ('29 rows, 10 names cut; versions cut 6, slivers 0; badges 2, clipped 0'). So this is a recorded design decision that differs from the exemplar, not a defect, and the main-panel artboard does not draw side bar compact rows to compare against.
